title: 2023 Panini Prizm #312 Jonathan Mingo Carolina Panthers Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2023 Panini Prizm 312 Jonathan Mingo RC card is a must-have for any Carolina Panthers fan or sports trading card collector. The card features a stunning design with a Prizm parallel/variety and showcases the rookie talent of Jonathan Mingo.

With a standard card size and manufactured by Panini, this sports trading card is perfect for any NFL enthusiast. The card is unsigned and does not include an autograph, but it still holds great value. Don't miss out on the chance to add this unique card to your collection and show off your love for the Carolina Panthers.
